task: Mina has moved into a new flat and is having a housewarming party. She wants an AI to draft the invitation email to her friends. Mina is fictional, and so is every AI reply in this quiz.
scenario: Mina wants an AI to draft the invitation email for her housewarming party.

stages.title: Set the criterion
stages.label: What this stage checks
stages.purpose: whether you can tell a criterion you can check from one you cannot. You decide what a useful result looks like before you ask, so that you can judge the reply.

stages.title: Choose the context
stages.label: What this stage practises
stages.purpose: choosing context. You give an AI what helps with this task, and you leave out what is unrelated or private.

stages.title: Check the reply
stages.label: What this stage practises
stages.purpose: checking a reply against your criterion and your own notes, then correcting it with a specific instruction.

stages.title: Keep what worked
stages.label: What this stage checks
stages.purpose: whether you know what belongs in each of your three documents, and what to keep out of them.

criteria.question: Before Mina asks the AI, she decides what a useful invitation looks like. Which of these can she check when the reply comes back?

options.feedback: Mina cannot check “really good”. Any fluent reply would seem to pass. Try another.

options.text: Under 80 words, friendly, gives the date and time, and says what to bring.
options.feedback: Yes. Mina can count the words, and she can look for the date, the time and what to bring.

options.text: It should sound like something I would write.
options.feedback: That matters to Mina, but she cannot check it until she says what her writing is like. Try another.

criterion: Under 80 words, friendly, gives the date and time, and says what to bring.

cards.text: The email goes to my close friends. Most of them know each other.
The party is on Saturday 21 June from 6 pm at my new flat. Leave a placeholder for the address. I will add it myself.
People should bring a drink to share. I am providing the food.
Keep it plain and friendly. No shouting.
I also need to book a dentist appointment.
My laptop battery does not last long.
My friend Priya has just lost her job, so she may not be able to bring anything.
My address is Flat 5, 22 Wattle Street. The door code is 4471.

packed.text: Hi everyone, I have moved, and I would love you to come to my housewarming.

unpacked.text: Dear valued guests, you are cordially invited to a housewarming celebration.
unpacked.why: The AI was not told who the email is for, so it guessed. The result is not friendly.

packed.text: It is on Saturday 21 June from 6 pm at my new flat. Address: [to be added].

unpacked.text: It is this Saturday at 7 pm.
unpacked.why: The AI was not told the date or the time, so it made them up.

packed.text: Please bring a drink to share. Food is provided.

unpacked.text: Please bring a plate of food and a gift.
unpacked.why: The AI guessed what to bring. Mina’s note says a drink to share, and that she is providing the food.

unpacked.text: It is going to be the PARTY OF THE YEAR!!!
unpacked.why: The AI was not told how the email should sound, so it chose for itself.

packed.text: There is plenty of parking on the street.
packed.why: None of Mina’s notes mentions parking. An AI can add a detail that sounds right even when the context is good. That is why you check.

packed.text: P.S. Can anyone recommend a dentist?
packed.why: The dentist note had nothing to do with this task, and the AI used it anyway.

packed.text: Sorry if this email is short. My laptop battery does not last long.
packed.why: The laptop note had nothing to do with this task, and the AI used it anyway.

packed.text: Priya, you do not need to bring anything now that you have lost your job.
packed.why: This is another person’s private information. Once it is in the conversation, it can appear in the result.

packed.text: The address is Flat 5, 22 Wattle Street, and the door code is 4471.
packed.why: Mina planned to add the address herself, and the AI never needed the door code. Now both are in a group email.

correction.question: The parking sentence is still in the invitation. What should Mina say next?
correction.paper_question: The parking sentence is one of them. What should Mina say to the AI?

options.feedback: The AI cannot tell what “better” means to Mina. It may change the wrong thing. Try another.

options.text: You said there is plenty of parking. I did not say that. Remove it, and do not add details I have not given you.
options.feedback: Yes. Mina names the problem, says what to change and gives a rule that will help next time.

options.text: Say nothing. Ask the same question again in a new conversation.
options.feedback: The AI would know nothing more than before, so the same kind of guess is likely. Try another.

correction.fixed: Hi everyone, I have moved, and I would love you to come to my housewarming. It is on Saturday 21 June from 6 pm at my new flat. Address: [to be added]. Please bring a drink to share. Food is provided.

about: how Mina wants an AI to work with her on any task
what she is working towards, and the next step
facts and examples worth using again

items.text: Do not add details I have not given you. Ask me instead.
items.why: This is how Mina wants an AI to work with her on any task.

items.text: Goal: housewarming party on Saturday 21 June. Next step: send the invitation this week.
items.why: This is a goal and its next step.

items.text: An invitation that worked: short and friendly, with the date and time first and what to bring last.
items.why: This is an example of what worked. Mina can use it again for her next invitation.

items.text: The door code for my building is 4471.
items.why: Private details do not belong in notes Mina will paste into an AI conversation.

takeaways.text: Decide what a useful result looks like before you ask.
Give the AI what helps with this task. Leave out what is unrelated or private.
Check the result against your criterion, and correct it with a specific instruction.
Keep what worked in your three documents, so you can use it again.
